name: Tasks
description: Kanban task manager connecting to your own Vikunja instance — create, assign, filter tasks and manage projects and labels.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_tasks
tools.description: Background: today/overdue/upcoming counts + recent tasks + active projects.

tools.name: skeleton_alert_tasks
tools.description: Alert on new overdue tasks or today's task count changes.

tools.name: connect_vikunja
tools.description: Connect a user's Vikunja instance via username + password. The password is forwarded to the backend service once, exchanged for a long-lived Personal Access Token, and discarded. Only the encrypted PAT is stored. Returns base_url + username on success.

base_url.description: Your Vikunja base URL, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com
base_url.title: Base Url

password.description: Your Vikunja password (used once to mint a long-lived API token, never stored).
password.title: Password

tools.name: connect_vikunja_with_pat
tools.description: Advanced connect: user pastes a pre-existing Vikunja Personal Access Token (Settings → API tokens in their Vikunja UI). The PAT is encrypted on bridge and stored at rest.

params_schema.description: Advanced: user pastes a pre-existing PAT minted in their Vikunja UI.

pat.description: Vikunja Personal Access Token (Settings → API tokens).
pat.title: Pat

params_schema.title: ConnectVikunjaWithPatParams

tools.name: disconnect_vikunja
tools.description: Disconnect from the user's Vikunja: revoke the stored API token in their instance and delete the local connection record.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Check whether the user has a Vikunja connected (read-only — never echoes the API token). Returns connected: bool plus base_url and username when connected.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a project. Returns task_id + full task details.

bucket_id.description: Kanban bucket; default = first bucket of project.
bucket_id.title: Bucket Id

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update any fields of a task (title, description, due_date, priority, percent_done, bucket, etc.).

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as done (done=true, percent_done=1.0).

tools.name: uncomplete_task
tools.description: Reopen a task — mark it as not done (done=false, percent_done=0). Inverse of complete_task.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_subtask
tools.description: Create a subtask under a parent task. Returns the new subtask's task_id.

tools.name: list_subtasks
tools.description: List all subtasks of a given task, including their done/pending status.

task_id.description: Parent task ID to list subtasks for.
task_id.title: Task Id

tools.name: toggle_checklist_item
tools.description: Check or uncheck a TipTap checklist item in a task description. Use item_index (0-based) from the visible checklist order.

task_id.description: Task whose description checklist to update.
task_id.title: Task Id

item_index.description: Zero-based index of the checklist item.
item_index.title: Item Index

checked.description: True to mark done, False to uncheck.
checked.title: Checked

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get full details of a single task by ID: title, description, done status, due date, priority, assignees, labels, and project. Use this to verify task state before updating, or when user asks about a specific task.

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description: Assign a person to a task. Pass task_name + assignee_query directly — do NOT call find_task or get_named_bucket_tasks first. If multiple tasks share the same name, also pass bucket_name to pick the right one. The bridge resolves assignee_query (name or email) to a Vikunja user ID automatically.

task_id.description: Integer task ID. Pass 0 when you only know the task by name — task_name will be used to auto-resolve it. Do NOT call find_task first.
task_id.title: Task Id

task_name.description: Task title to search for when task_id is unknown. Call assign_task directly with task_name — do NOT pre-search with find_task. If multiple tasks share the same name, also pass bucket_name to disambiguate.
task_name.title: Task Name

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name to disambiguate when multiple tasks share the same title (e.g. 'the team'). Case-insensitive. Used only when task_name is set.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

assignee_query.description: Name or email of the person to assign (e.g. 'ignat', 'ignat@webhostmost.com'). The bridge resolves it to a Vikunja user ID automatically.
assignee_query.title: Assignee Query

tools.name: unassign_task
tools.description: Remove a Vikunja user (by integer user ID) from a task's assignee list.

assignee_vikunja_user_id.description: Integer Vikunja user ID (same one used in assign_task).
assignee_vikunja_user_id.title: Assignee Vikunja User Id

tools.name: add_label
tools.description: Attach an existing label (by integer label_id) to a task (by integer task_id). If you only know the label name, call create_label or ask the user for the numeric label_id — Vikunja addresses labels by ID, never by name.

label_id.description: Integer label ID — obtain via create_label response or Vikunja UI. Never label name.
label_id.title: Label Id

tools.name: remove_label
tools.description: Detach a label (by integer label_id) from a task (by integer task_id).

label_id.description: Integer label ID currently attached to this task.
label_id.title: Label Id

tools.name: set_due_date
tools.description: Set or change due date of a task. Pass integer task_id and due_date as ISO 8601 UTC string (e.g. '2026-04-25T12:00:00Z'). Convert relative dates ('Friday', 'tomorrow') in user's timezone first.

tools.name: set_priority
tools.description: Set task priority — integer 0 (none) to 5 (critical). Pass integer task_id.

tools.name: move_to_project
tools.description: Move a task to another project. Pass integer task_id and integer project_id (from list_projects response — never project name).

project_id.description: Integer project ID from list_projects response. Never project name.
project_id.title: Project Id

tools.name: move_to_bucket
tools.description: Move a task to another kanban bucket (column). Pass integer task_id and integer bucket_id (from list_buckets response — never bucket name). Call list_buckets first if bucket_id is unknown.

bucket_id.description: Integer bucket ID from list_buckets response. Never bucket name.
bucket_id.title: Bucket Id

tools.name: search_vikunja_users
tools.description: Search for Vikunja users by name or email fragment — use this before assign_task to discover who is available, or when the user asks who they can assign tasks to. Pass empty query to list all known users on the Vikunja instance.

query.description: Name or email fragment to search for (e.g. 'val', 'ignat', 'denis@'). Pass empty string to list all known users on this Vikunja instance.
query.title: Query

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project (kanban board). Returns project_id.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update project title, description, or color.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.description: Archive a project (is_archived=true) — hide from active views but keep data.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project with all its tasks. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List all labels on this Vikunja instance. Returns label_id and title. Call this first when the user refers to a label by name — then use the returned label_id in add_label.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new label with title and optional hex color. Returns label_id.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Permanently delete a label — removes it from all tasks.

label_id.description: Integer label ID from list_labels response. Never a name.
label_id.title: Label Id

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all active (non-archived) projects. Returns project_id and title. ALWAYS call this first when the user refers to a project by name — then use the returned project_id in list_buckets, filter_tasks, or create_task.

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: List kanban buckets (columns) for a project WITH their tasks embedded. REQUIRES project_id — call list_projects() first if you only know the project name. Returns bucket_id, title, task_count, and full task list per bucket. Use for: (1) get tasks from a named bucket — read from the tasks array directly; (2) resolve bucket name → bucket_id before move_to_bucket or create_task; (3) count total tasks in a project (sum all task_count values). NOTE: filter_tasks cannot filter by bucket — this is the only way to get bucket tasks.

project_id.description: Integer project ID. REQUIRED — call list_projects() first if you only know the project name.
project_id.title: Project Id

tools.name: list_project_buckets
tools.description: List kanban columns (buckets) for a project — names and IDs only, NO task data. Fast and lightweight. Use this to resolve a bucket name → bucket_id before calling get_bucket_tasks, move_to_bucket, or create_task with a specific bucket.

project_id.description: Integer project ID from list_projects. Call list_projects() first if you only know the project name.
project_id.title: Project Id

BucketNavItem.description: Lightweight bucket descriptor — no embedded tasks.
BucketNavItem.title: BucketNavItem

return_schema.description: Result of list_project_buckets — names/IDs only, no task data.
return_schema.title: ListProjectBucketsResult

tools.name: get_bucket_tasks
tools.description: Get tasks from a specific bucket (column) by integer bucket_id. Returns ONLY tasks from that bucket — nothing else. Use list_project_buckets() first to resolve a bucket name to bucket_id. Prefer get_named_bucket_tasks() when you only know the name.

tools.name: get_named_bucket_tasks
tools.description: Get tasks from a bucket by project name + bucket name. Resolves names to IDs automatically and returns ONLY those tasks. USE THIS as the primary way to get tasks from a named bucket — one call does everything: project lookup, bucket lookup, task retrieval. Names are case-insensitive and support prefix matching.

project_name.description: Project name as the user said it (e.g. 'WebHostMost Tasks'). Case-insensitive, prefix match.
project_name.title: Project Name

bucket_name.description: Bucket/column name as the user said it (e.g. 'the team'). Case-insensitive, prefix match.
bucket_name.title: Bucket Name

tools.name: rename_bucket
tools.description: Rename a kanban bucket (column) or update its WIP limit. Requires project_id and bucket_id — use list_project_buckets() first if you only know the bucket name.

limit.description: WIP limit (0 = no limit). Omit to keep existing.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Create a new kanban column (bucket) in a project. Requires project_id — use list_projects() first if you only know the project name. Optional WIP limit: 0 means no limit.

limit.description: WIP limit (0 = no limit). Omit for unlimited.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: delete_bucket
tools.description: Delete a kanban column (bucket) from a project. Irreversible — tasks in the deleted column are moved to the project's default column, not deleted. Requires project_id and bucket_id — call list_project_buckets() first if you only know the name.

tools.name: list_my_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional Vikunja filter syntax. Examples: `done = false`, `priority >= 3 && due_date < now + 7d`.

filter.description: Vikunja filter syntax, e.g. 'done = false && project_id = 5'.
filter.title: Filter

sort_by.description: Field name; prefix with '-' for desc, e.g. 'due_date' or '-priority'.
sort_by.title: Sort By

tools.name: list_overdue
tools.description: List all overdue tasks (done=false AND due_date in the past).

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: list_today
tools.description: List tasks due today (done=false AND due_date between start-of-day and end-of-day).

params_schema.description: Empty Pydantic params model for no-arg @chat.function handlers (V17 compliance).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: find_task
tools.description: Search tasks by title substring. Returns matching tasks with their integer task_id and project_id. Call this first when the user mentions a task by name and you don't have its integer ID — never invent task_id.

query.description: Substring of task title to search for. Returns matching tasks with their integer task_id, project_id, bucket_id.
query.title: Query

tools.name: filter_tasks
tools.description: Filter tasks with Vikunja expression. Operators: = != > < >= <= in like. Logical: && ||. Time helpers: now, now/d, now+7d, now-3d. Fields: title, description, done, due_date, start_date, end_date, priority, project_id, percent_done.

filter.description: Vikunja filter expression, e.g. 'done = false && project_id = 5'. If omitted, returns ALL tasks (no filter applied). NOTE: bucket_id is not a valid filter field — use list_buckets instead.
filter.title: Filter

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task (markdown supported).

tools.name: mention_user
tools.description: Mention a user in a task comment. Vikunja auto-links '@username' and notifies. Use when user wants to notify/loop in someone.

username.description: Vikunja username to mention (without @). Vikunja auto-links and notifies.
username.title: Username

message.description: Optional context around the mention. If empty, plain '@username' is posted.
message.title: Message

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a task.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Edit the text of an existing comment on a task.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment from a task. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: ai_breakdown_task
tools.description: Break a task into subtasks using AI. Fetches the task title and description, generates N actionable subtask titles, then creates each as a real Vikunja subtask. Use when user says 'break this task into subtasks', 'разбей задачу', 'create a plan', or similar. Returns the list of created subtask IDs and titles.

task_id.description: ID of the task to break down into subtasks.
task_id.title: Task Id

context.description: Optional extra context or instructions for the breakdown.
context.title: Context
